objects.name: cartoon shark
objects.caption: A cartoonish turquoise shark with a wide open mouth showing sharp white teeth, wearing a red bowtie; it stands upright on two legs on the sand, with a friendly yet exaggerated expression and smooth plastic-like surface finish.

objects.name: beach umbrella
objects.caption: A large beach umbrella with alternating red and white radial stripes, made of fabric stretched over a central pole and ribs; it is planted vertically in the sand, tilted slightly toward the viewer, casting a soft shadow.

objects.name: rubber duck
objects.caption: A small yellow rubber duck with an orange beak and black eyes, floating on the water near the shore; its glossy surface suggests molded plastic, and it is positioned horizontally with slight tilt.

objects.name: octagonal rock
objects.caption: A dark gray, irregularly shaped octagonal rock with a matte stone texture and a lighter gray patch on one side; it lies flat on the sandy ground in the foreground, partially buried.

objects.name: beach chair
objects.caption: A red folding beach chair with a simple wooden frame and fabric seat/back; it is set up on the sand, angled slightly left, with visible leg supports and a relaxed recline posture.

objects.name: palm tree
objects.caption: A stylized palm tree with a slender brown trunk curving gently to the right and a crown of broad green fronds; the trunk appears smooth and cartoon-rendered, rooted in the sand near the water’s edge.
